current_director_design: Director Plan 3.1 forbids layout, color, composition and visual resource fields; PPT Master owns page design.
reason: The current boundary already separates instruction/discovery from executable design capability and does not duplicate PPT Master.

current_director_design: Capabilities use available_tool, available_model_workflow, degraded and unavailable, with execution_type and verified=false for model workflows.
reason: Four states plus evidence distinguish deterministic tools from instruction-driven workflows without adding false precision.

current_director_design: The snapshot uses a hand-maintained runtime fingerprint and raw file hashes that include captured_at, absolute paths and display fields.
reason: Freshness must follow the actual capability entry/reference closure and dependency versions while excluding timestamps and presentation-only fields.

current_director_design: A single context_rehydrate.md lists required files, hashes and the current page, but includes refreshed_at and absolute paths.
reason: Keep one derived context view, but make its schema, logical paths, ordering and semantic hash deterministic; it must not become state.

current_director_design: route.py appends capability_preflight_started and finished only after dispatch has completed.
reason: Started must be emitted before the call, followed by completed or failed with the same operation id; post-hoc lifecycle events are misleading.

current_director_design: Mode selection can return model_workflow_required, but logging may still label template analysis as finished.
reason: When the host cannot observe the model call, record context_issued and later artifacts_observed or gate_failed, never a fabricated started/completed pair.

current_director_design: events.jsonl is append-only while production_state.json stores only the current workflow gate.
reason: This separation provides audit history without turning Production State into an event store.

current_director_design: Three bounded directories hold A/B/C artifacts for the same two pages, with per-file hashes and a selected_sample record.
reason: File branches exactly match the bounded decision; a full Session tree would add replay, migration and second-state complexity without benefit.

current_director_design: Production State and selected sample files already model the complete PPT workflow and bounded candidate decision.
reason: Pi Session stores complete conversational history and arbitrary forks; importing it would create a second Agent framework and state model.

current_director_design: A single Production State stores stage, active page, hashes, samples, pages, reviews and export gate.
reason: It is a current-state projection and already covers every deterministic transition required by PPT production.

current_director_design: Global hash changes reset samples to a generic standard structure and can drop three_groups directions.
reason: Invalidation must preserve the selected mode's state shape by reusing the existing _sample_state helper, not create a new state model.

current_director_design: Premium plan is blocked until templates/design_spec.md exists, even though the fixed pipeline creates the project design system after the Director Plan.
reason: Mode handling may invoke Master tools and issue workflow context, but the Director must not own or require the final project design spec before planning.

current_director_design: generation_modes.yaml defines static modes, generation_mode.json records the project choice, and production_state.json records current execution state.
reason: The current separation is clear and does not require a generic configuration or session service.

current_director_design: A single public Skill dispatches to a fixed internal PPT Master runtime.
reason: Adding Pi-style dynamic extensions or resource discovery would duplicate the fixed Master runtime and violate the single-Skill boundary.

current_director_design: 3.1 retains narrow compatibility for existing plan and production formats without a general migration framework.
reason: No current 3.1 requirement needs arbitrary historical session migration; add a narrow migration only after a concrete persisted-format break appears.

current_director_design: PPT Master machine check, rendering, Visual Review, midpoint, deck review and can-export are reused through the production module.
reason: These are deterministic calls already owned by PPT Master; adding parallel Review or export receipts would duplicate proven mechanisms.

current_director_design: Existing tests cover mode availability and grouped sample equality but not event ordering, semantic hash stability, grouped invalidation or premium ordering.
reason: Add only narrow regression tests for the identified gaps; do not copy Pi's workspace-wide release system.
